title: 고등법원 부장판사급 이상의 법관의 보직범위에 관한 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:02831:20190201:00007:part:1/1
title_original: 고등법원 부장판사급 이상의 법관의 보직범위에 관한 규칙
full_text:
ADDENDUM <Supreme Court Rule No. 2831, February 1, 2019>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation and shall apply from February 14, 2019.

Article 2 (Transitional Measures)
The former provisions shall apply to a judge who was appointed as president of a court at any level while serving as a presiding judge of a district court before these Rules entered into force.
